sections: Hero: Full height, dark background with image overlay (bg-black/80), massive H1, Primary CTA to App.
Features: 3-column grid explaining lead capture, tracking, and fast follow-up.

lead_capture.layout: Centered form container on a dark background
lead_capture.description: Public-facing form for leads to submit details.

dashboard.description: Pre-seeded with 3-5 leads. Table view of leads with status badges.

lead_detail.description: Left: Lead details and history. Right: Template-based message generator (Select template, edit, copy).

accessibility.contrast_strategy: High contrast white text on dark zinc backgrounds. Accent colors tested for WCAG AA.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements must use data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: This project uses .js/.jsx files. Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx/.ts).
Install specific fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: Barlow and IBM Plex Sans.
Enforce dark mode permanently (e.g., set <html class='dark'>). Avoid light mode. The entire app is dark theme.
Mock the 3-5 leads data in a centralized store or context. Include Business name, Customer name, Phone, Service category, Message, Status, Received time.

Implement template-based message generator (no AI). Provide a dropdown of 3 templates (e.g., 'Standard Follow-up', 'Busy - Call later', 'Quote Ready'). Selecting one fills a textarea with placeholders replaced by lead data.
Strictly follow the color palette provided in Tailwind classes (e.g., text-orange-500, bg-zinc-950).
Use custom Shadcn components styled with sharp borders (rounded-sm) and the defined input styles.
Add data-testid attributes to ALL buttons, inputs, links, and actionable elements.
